summary: This app uses zero experimental, preview, RC, or canary APIs: it is built entirely on React Router's long-stable framework-mode surface (route config, root.tsx document layout, loader/meta, Link/useSearchParams) at the current stable version 8.5.1. It also avoids the APIs deprecated in 8.5 (view-transition props) and the unstable v8 additions (api-only mode, custom route discovery, RSC). From an experimentalness standpoint it is maximally conservative with essentially no upgrade risk.
